text:
laura: Hey finance — spotted a weird double charge on my corporate card from SFO Centurion Lounge yesterday, one for $57.00 and another for $57.00. I only used the lounge once. Receipt only shows a single charge. attaching screenshot in thread. can file expense but wanted to flag before I submit.

sam_accounting: thanks for flagging, laura. can you drop the transaction ids or a screenshot of the statement? we need merchant name, date, amount, and txn id to open a dispute.

laura: sure — here's the quick copy from the card portal:

```
Merchant: SFO Centurion Lounge
Date: 2026-03-12
Amount: $57.00
Txn ID: 544331-AB12
Merchant: SFO Centurion Lounge
Date: 2026-03-12
Amount: $57.00
Txn ID: 544332-AB13
```

jeff_travel: ugh that sucks. did you happen to pay with the physical corp card or virtual one? if virtual, we should lock it and issue a new vcard.

laura: physical card in my wallet. not lost though. both txns show as "completed" on the portal.

sam_accounting: understood. i'll start a dispute with the card provider. @opsbot can you create a ticket in SpendOps with label "card-dispute" and attach laura's statement?

opsbot: Ticket created: SP-2026-489. Linked to laura's email thread. Next step: Finance to submit dispute form within 3 business days.

sam_accounting: thanks. laura, for your expense report, go ahead and submit only one lounge line for $57 and add a note: "duplicate charge under dispute (SP-2026-489)". We'll keep the other as pending non-reimbursable until dispute resolves.

laura: sounds good. one question — if dispute is denied, can I get reimbursed for the second charge? our travel policy says "reimbursable if merchant error proven or upon dispute denial with manager approval." who signs off?

jeff_travel: manager approval required per policy. ping me or your manager and we'll sign if dispute is denied and there's evidence it was a mistaken duplicate. also keep receipts and any lounge staff emails.

sam_accounting: cool. I'll update the ticket and loop in the corporate card provider. ETA for first response 5-7 business days. I'll post updates here. :thumbsup:

laura: thanks all — submitted the expense with the note and attached screenshots. appreciate the quick help.

sam_accounting: got it. marking thread SP-2026-489. will update when dispute status changes.

opsbot: Reminder scheduled: follow up on SP-2026-489 in 7 days."
